name: Building Each Other Up
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of mutual encouragement and spiritual strengthening within the community of believers. Proverbs 27:17 illustrates how believers sharpen one another like iron sharpens iron, while Ecclesiastes 4:9 highlights the greater effectiveness of working together. Romans 14:19 and 15:1 call Christians to pursue peace and bear one another’s weaknesses, promoting unity and edification. Additionally, Ephesians 4:11 and 4:29 reveal that God equips the church with various leaders and instructs believers to use wholesome speech to build up others and minister grace.
